author: CODEX SOL 6.1

claimRepresentation.rawAnswer: Exact decoded product message bound to exact response bytes/digest; no editor-normalized answer.
claimRepresentation.offsets: Half-open UTF-8 byte offsets in encoded decoded-message string, separately bound to rawOutputSha256.
claimRepresentation.atomicity: Split distinct subjects, predicates, polarity, modalities, conditions, numeric claims, attribution and authority statements; implied material conclusions count. Keep necessary context/qualifiers.
claimRepresentation.inventory: Independent reviewer checks exhaustive material-claim census; an omitted unsupported claim invalidates the adjudication.

passageRepresentation: Exact authorized historical UTF-8 bytes with identity, locator, hash, authority relation and gold pointer; permitted passage sets never widened to document/question/current record.
materialBoundary: A claim about Academy content, material course facts, provenance, authority or inferred conclusion that affects the answer. Greetings/style/preferences are nonmaterial. Abstention boundary assertions are checked against frozen answerability/expectedAbstentionBoundary; never fabricated as Academy passage support.

checks: Validate schema plus span bounds and byte substring equality.
Verify benchmark/gold member/item hashes, exact authority artifact identities and authorized evidence resolution.
Confirm each material Academy claim cites authorized gold/positive alternative evidence of correct course and appropriate proposition scope; negative controls are rejected.
Check frozen supportsPropositions references and preserve scoped corrections; role labels are semantic enums, not numerical ranks.
d4A.passRule: All applicable identity checks PASS; null unresolved required binding cannot pass.
d4A.abstention: No Academy factual claim: identity checks may be NOT_APPLICABLE. Item-level PASS requires independent confirmation of the empty Academy-claim census; unsupported positive claims cannot be hidden as abstention.

d4B.adjudicator: Owner-authorized independent semantic reviewer; neither runner/scorer implementation author nor contract author can be final adjudicator.
inputs: Immutable raw answer and exhaustive atomic claim inventory
Exact authorized passage bytes and checked D4-A trace
Relevant frozen required/prohibited propositions, acceptable alternatives, answerability, inference boundaries and scoped correction in restricted scorer stage only
d4B.supportRelation: The passage entails the entire material claim under its actual course/subject/conditions, without external knowledge or unauthorized premise. Several authorized passages may jointly support a synthesis; preserve which span supports each conjunct.

judgments.SUPPORTED: All material parts entailed with qualifications preserved.
judgments.PARTIAL: Only some components supported; split to atomic parts and preserve unsupported remainder; never automatic PASS.
judgments.UNSUPPORTED: No authorized support for at least one material claim.
judgments.CONTRADICTED: Authorized passage conflicts with claim, including lost caveat or wrong polarity.
judgments.AMBIGUOUS: Available passage cannot resolve support with confidence; scoring unresolved, not PASS.
judgments.ABSTAINED: Reviewer declines judgment; requires another authorized independent reviewer before closure.
judgments.ADJUDICATION_FAILURE: Missing/corrupt inputs, output, reviewer identity or receipt; scoring failure, not product-quality failure by default.

d4B.abstention: Evaluate refusal/named gaps against exact frozen boundary. A model refusing a required answer is recorded in D2/D7/D8; it cannot receive invented positive passage support.

passRule: D4_PASS = D4_A_PASS AND D4_B_PASS. Every applicable material Academy claim must be SUPPORTED; PARTIAL/UNSUPPORTED/CONTRADICTED fail support, AMBIGUOUS/ABSTAINED/ADJUDICATION_FAILURE block a final result. No compensation.
evidencePreservation: Store raw answer, inventory revisions, exact cited passage bytes/digests, offsets, identity check receipts, reviewer outputs and disagreement history immutably. No post-hoc answer/gold edits.
independentAccess: Least privilege restricted scorer package and audit store after run output freeze; read-only access to all relevant evidence and gold. D3 authors receive no item/gold selection. Implementation authors receive open fixtures only.
failureSeparation: Wrong product claims produce dimension/gate failures; absent evidence authority or failed reviewer infrastructure produces scoring/authority failure with quality undecided. Never uncertainty->PASS.
